headline: Trump glitches on the date at 9/11 speech

beats.text: Speaking at the Pentagon on the twenty-fifth anniversary of September eleventh, Trump paid tribute to the victims -- while New York's own Ground Zero memorial has banned speeches at its ceremony since 2012.

beats.caption: ...remember the victims and the families of September 11th,
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Then came a pause that stretched on.
So how'd he stick the landing?
That wasn't his only 9/11 story. Earlier that week he claimed firefighters carried him to safety near the Twin Towers -- a claim the White House dismissed as the Daily Beast 'grasping at straws.'

beats.caption: "Grabbed me under the arm, said, 'Got to get out of here.' And they literally lifted me up."
beats.label: Trump, via CNN
